profile.title: Alert & safety profile
profile.lead: Eight indices on five axes, from the counts of the expert rules: the criticality ones, and the safety ones that balance them. Each is a share of the risks.

severity.criticality: The share of the risks of high severity.
severity.safety: The share of the risks of low or medium severity.

exposure.criticality: The share of the risks that occur after deployment.

prevention.criticality: The share of the risks that do not occur before deployment.
prevention.safety: The share of the risks that occur before deployment, when they can still be prevented.

intent.criticality: The share of the intentional risks.
intent.safety: The share of the unintentional risks.

entity.safety: The share of the risks caused by people.

profile.label: The alert and safety profile on five axes

patterns.title: Risk patterns
patterns.lead: The 18 patterns of the expert rules, each a combination of severity and causes, by group and by the cause that the rule names. A risk can match more than one pattern.
patterns.empty: The rules have no low-severity pattern for AI or for people: those cells stay empty.

entity.ai: The risk is caused by a decision or action made by an AI system.
entity.human: The risk is caused by a decision or action made by humans.
entity.other: The risk is caused by some other reason or is ambiguous.

intent.intentional: The risk occurs due to an expected outcome from pursuing a goal.
intent.unintentional: The risk occurs due to an unexpected outcome from pursuing a goal.
intent.other: The risk is presented as occurring without clearly specifying the intentionality.

timing.pre-deployment: The risk occurs before the AI is deployed.
timing.post-deployment: The risk occurs after the AI model has been trained and deployed.
timing.other: The risk is presented without a clearly specified time of occurrence.
